claims.claim: **Most drowning causes minimal or no respiratory impairment** and needs no admission beyond a period of observation.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **The terms 'near-drowning', 'wet drowning' and 'secondary drowning' have fallen out of use** and have no bearing on management.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Timeline:** how long immersed · when basic life support began and what kind · how long until the first respiratory effort.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Consider supervision and safety:** look for inconsistencies in the story, or a story incompatible with developmental age.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **In a competent swimmer, look for a medical cause:** seizures, hypoglycaemia, arrhythmias including Long QT syndrome, intoxication.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Cervical spine injury is uncommon** but consider it with a history of trauma such as diving.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Asymptomatic, alert children need no investigations**; otherwise be guided by history and condition. **Outcome does not track chest X-ray findings.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Altered mental state without significant hypoxia → look for another cause:** hypoglycaemia, hypothermia, traumatic brain injury, or a co-existing medical condition.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **ECG** may help diagnose arrhythmias and Long QT syndrome.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Principles: maintain oxygenation, prevent aspiration, stabilise body temperature.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Vomiting and aspiration of gastric contents are common and a major complication — place spontaneously breathing children in the recovery (lateral decubitus) position.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **No prophylactic antibiotics.** Reserve antibiotics for signs of infection or sepsis, or the rare submersion in grossly contaminated water.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Hypothermia is common:** remove wet clothes, dry the child, minimise exposure.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **If core temperature is below 34 °C and brain injury is not evident, actively rewarm to normothermia** — warmed IV fluids, humidified oxygen, forced-air warming blankets.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Hypoxic brain injury:** there is some evidence for therapeutic hypothermia — **discuss with a paediatric intensivist.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Consult the paediatric team** for increased respiratory effort, **SpO2 under 95%**, abnormal lung examination, or a suspected underlying medical cause.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Consider transfer** for persisting altered conscious state, respiratory compromise needing assisted ventilation, or ongoing hypoxia.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Discharge when:** **8 hours of observation since the drowning**, no symptoms, normal respiratory examination, **SpO2 ≥95%**, water-safety education given, no ongoing safety concerns, and social work referral made if appropriate.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Adverse prognostic indicators:** submersion over 5 minutes · effective basic life support after more than 10 minutes · arrival with CPR in progress · GCS under 5 · rectal temperature under 30 °C · arterial pH under 7.1 on arrival.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Drowning' (Last Updated June 2020), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Drowning/, retrieved 2026-09-23
